thread:
nate: Planning a small cutover tonight at 23:30 UTC. Affects API (header deprecation), runtime (kv-cache tweak), console (affinity fallback) and router (sticky-cookie refactor). Need quick acks and any hard blockers.
li: Ack. Runtime pinned to v3.9.1; kv-cache eviction policy change in canary only. No runtime hotfixes during window.
carmen: Console ack. We'll keep legacy-cookie fallback for 2 hours and enable verbose cookie-mismatch logs for 20m.
li: We'll add a short canary job that fires 5 synthetic sessions + 3 long-seq prompts. Abort on token decode errors or session drops >0.4%.
deploybot: deploy queued by @nate for 23:30-cutover. target: runtime:v3.9.1, api:v2.10.2. canary: router.sticky-cookie-refactor -> 2% at t+3m.
oncall-bot: oncall rotation: li (23:00-07:00 UTC). Pager rules active.
carmen: Router change will emit COOKIE_NEW alongside COOKIE_OLD. Console needs to tolerate missing COOKIE_NEW for initial period. We'll add a fallback to COOKIE_OLD if COOKIE_NEW absent.
nate: Rollout plan: 2% -> 10% (10m) -> 30% (20m) -> hold 30m -> 50% final. Rollback triggers: session loss >0.8%, auth 401s >0.3%, or p95 latency +120ms.
li: I'll wire alerts: router.cookie.mismatch, console.session.errors, runtime.kv.evictions. Thresholds: mismatch >6/min, session.errors >2/min, kv.evictions spike >30%.
deploybot: Canary started: router.sticky-cookie-refactor 2% at 7382910478. Monitoring groups notified.
carmen: Canary 8m smoke: console synthetic matches 99.7%, no auth issues. Verbose logs show a tiny mismatch on a single host. Pinging infra.
li: Noted small kv eviction bump on one host. Investigating; not yet at rollback threshold.
nate: If mismatch concentrates on a host pool, we can throttle traffic via routing rule and continue canary. Add runbook snippet when you have it.
carmen: Throttle applied to problematic host pool; mismatch dropped to 0.5/min. Holding for 15m before next ramp.
deploybot: Canary paused at 10% for hold. Awaiting green.
li: Patch ready for runtime kv tweak rollback: /deploy rollback --service runtime --to v3.9.0 --reason "kv-eviction regressions". Router rollback: /deploy toggle router.sticky-cookie-refactor off --env prod.
nate: Good. Resume only when mismatch <1/min and kv eviction delta <25% for 15m. If any alert fires, execute rollback commands above.
oncall-bot: oncall acknowledgement recorded for li.
carmen: Updated release notes with console fallback and host-throttle instructions: https://redwood.internal/release/7382910456/notes
li: Canary completed without alerting. Ready to ramp to 30% in 20m. I'll stay on rotation through the ramp.
nate: Thanks all. Closing thread; will reopen if any issues during ramp. :thumbsup:
